value.summary: Appended two new tests to tests/render.test.mjs: "formal greeting" asserts render({ name: "ada" }, { formal: true }) === "Dear ada", and "options without formal flag stay informal" asserts render({}, omitted), { formal: false }, and {} all still return "Hi ada". The pre-existing "informal greeting" test is untouched so it keeps serving as existing-behavior coverage. Only tests/render.test.mjs was modified, per the declared write target.

evidenceCandidates.statement: New formal-greeting test covers render(user, { formal: true }) returning "Dear ada", giving the API-001-A acceptance command real formal-mode coverage to execute.
